query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.telemetry IS NOT NULL) AS "tasks_measured!", COALESCE(sum(t.duration_ms), 0)::int8 AS "busy_ms!", COALESCE(sum(t.wait_ms), 0)::int8 AS "wait_ms!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'requests')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "requests!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'fetch_ms')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "fetch_ms!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'pace_wait_ms')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "pace_wait_ms!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'solver_ms')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "solver_ms!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'solver_calls')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "solver_calls!", COALESCE(sum((t.telemetry->>'throttled')::int8), 0)::int8 AS "throttled!" FROM scan_tasks t WHERE t.run_id = $1
